शाभाका

ŚĀBHĀKĀ (śalākā) . See under dhanañjaya V.

सभानर

SABHĀNARA . A King of the bharata Dynasty. He was son of anudruhyu, and the father of Kālanara. (bhāgavata, skandha 9).

सभापर्व

SABHĀPARVA . An important section in the mahābhārata. The main theme mentioned in this section is the building of the palace of the pāṇḍavas. (Sabhā = palace).

सभापति

SABHĀPATI . A prince who took the side of the kauravas and fought against the pāṇḍavas. Mention is made in mahābhārata, karṇa Parva, Chapter 89, Śtanza 64, that this prince was killed by arjuna.
